content.json:
# Long Island Dance Events: how people use the site

How people use https://longisland.dance. The site counts page visits and clicks **without cookies and without knowing who anyone is**, so these numbers count visits, not people. Pick a time range at the top. Times are New York time where noted.

## Visitors at a glance

Quick numbers for the time range you picked. A **page view** is one page opening in a browser; one person can make many.

content.query:
let selected = customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange};
let current7 = toscalar(customEvents | where timestamp between (ago(7d) .. now()) | where name == "page_view" | count);
let previous7 = toscalar(customEvents | where timestamp between (ago(14d) .. ago(7d)) | where name == "page_view" | count);
let changePct = iif(previous7 == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * (current7 - previous7) / previous7, 1));
union
(print Sort = 1, Metric = "Page views", Value = todouble(toscalar(selected | where name == "page_view" | count)), Note = "All page loads in the selected time"),
(print Sort = 2, Metric = "Page views in the last 7 days", Value = todouble(current7), Note = "Compared with the 7 days before"),
(print Sort = 3, Metric = "Change from the 7 days before", Value = changePct, Note = iif(isnull(changePct), "No earlier-week data yet", strcat(tostring(changePct), "%"))),
(print Sort = 4, Metric = "Event pages viewed", Value = todouble(toscalar(selected | where name == "view_event" | count)), Note = "People opened event detail pages"),
(print Sort = 5, Metric = "Searches", Value = todouble(toscalar(selected | where name == "search" | count)), Note = "Visitor searches"),
(print Sort = 6, Metric = "Shares", Value = todouble(toscalar(selected | where name == "share" | count)), Note = "Share actions completed"),
(print Sort = 7, Metric = "Add-to-calendar clicks", Value = todouble(toscalar(selected | where name == "add_to_calendar" | count)), Note = "Calendar adds and feed subscriptions")
| order by Sort asc
| project Metric, Value, Note
content.title: Quick counts
content.subtitle: Cookieless first-party counts. No unique visitor IDs are used.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| summarize PageViews = count() by Day = startofday(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "America/New_York"))
| order by Day asc
content.title: Page views by day
content.subtitle: Shows how many pages were opened each day in New York time.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| summarize PageViews = count() by Week = startofweek(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "America/New_York"))
| order by Week asc
| serialize
| extend PreviousWeek = prev(PageViews)
| extend ChangeFromPreviousWeekPercent = iif(isnull(PreviousWeek) or PreviousWeek == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * (PageViews - PreviousWeek) / PreviousWeek, 1))
content.title: Page views by week
content.subtitle: Bars show each week, with the change from the week before.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name != "page_view"
| extend Method = tostring(customDimensions.method), Location = tostring(customDimensions.location), PageType = tostring(customDimensions.page_type)
| extend Method = iif(isempty(Method), "(none)", Method), Location = iif(isempty(Location), "(none)", Location), PageType = iif(isempty(PageType), "(none)", PageType)
| summarize Count = count() by Event = name, Method, Location, PageType
| order by Count desc
content.title: All tracked visitor actions
content.subtitle: A catch-all view for actions such as FAQ opens, theme changes, show-more clicks, empty states, copy failures, and consent changes.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in ("site.web.page_views", "site.web.event_views", "site.web.interactions", "site.web.consent_updates", "site.cms.auth")
| extend Metric = case(
    name == "site.web.page_views", "Page views metric",
    name == "site.web.event_views", "Event views metric",
    name == "site.web.interactions", "Interaction metric",
    name == "site.web.consent_updates", "Consent choice metric",
    name == "site.cms.auth", "CMS sign-in metric",
    name)
| extend Action = tostring(customDimensions.action), Method = tostring(customDimensions.method), Location = tostring(customDimensions.location), PageType = tostring(customDimensions.page_type), Result = tostring(customDimensions.result), Value = tostring(customDimensions.value)
| summarize Count = sum(valueSum) by Metric, Action, Method, Location, PageType, Result, Value
| order by Count desc
content.title: Counts recorded by the site
content.subtitle: A cross-check from metric rows for page views, event views, interactions, consent choices, and CMS sign-ins.

content.json:
## What people look at

See which events, places, performers, styles, towns, and pages get attention.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "view_event"
| extend EventSlug = tostring(customDimensions.event_slug), Entity = tostring(customDimensions.entity)
| extend EventKey = iif(isempty(Entity), strcat("event:", EventSlug), Entity)
| extend NameSlug = replace_regex(EventSlug, @"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-", "")
| extend EventName = iif(isempty(NameSlug), "Unknown event", replace_string(NameSlug, "-", " "))
| summarize Views = count(), ExampleSlug = any(EventSlug) by EventName, EventKey
| top 15 by Views desc
content.title: Top event series
content.subtitle: Shows the event pages people open most often. The name is simplified from the dated event slug.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend PageType = tostring(customDimensions.page_type), Entity = tostring(customDimensions.entity), Page = tostring(customDimensions.page)
| where PageType == "venue" or Entity startswith "venue:"
| extend VenueSlug = case(Entity startswith "venue:", substring(Entity, 6), Page startswith "/venues/", tostring(split(Page, "/")[2]), Page)
| extend Venue = replace_string(VenueSlug, "-", " ")
| summarize Views = count(), ExamplePage = any(Page) by Venue
| top 15 by Views desc
content.title: Top venues
content.subtitle: Venue pages or venue entities with the most page views.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend PageType = tostring(customDimensions.page_type), Entity = tostring(customDimensions.entity), Page = tostring(customDimensions.page)
| where PageType in ("person", "organizer", "performer", "instructor") or Entity startswith "performer:" or Entity startswith "instructor:" or Entity startswith "organizer:"
| extend Kind = case(Entity startswith "instructor:" or PageType == "instructor", "Teacher", Entity startswith "organizer:" or PageType == "organizer", "Organizer", "Band, DJ, or performer")
| extend RawName = case(isnotempty(Entity) and Entity contains ":", tostring(split(Entity, ":")[1]), Page startswith "/", replace_regex(Page, @"^.*/", ""), "unknown")
| extend Name = replace_string(RawName, "-", " ")
| summarize Views = count(), ExamplePage = any(Page) by Kind, Name
| top 15 by Views desc
content.title: Top bands, DJs, teachers, and organizers
content.subtitle: Person and organizer pages with the most views.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend PageType = tostring(customDimensions.page_type), Entity = tostring(customDimensions.entity), Page = tostring(customDimensions.page)
| where PageType == "style" or Entity startswith "style:"
| extend StyleSlug = case(Entity startswith "style:", substring(Entity, 6), Page startswith "/styles/", tostring(split(Page, "/")[2]), Page)
| extend Style = replace_string(StyleSlug, "-", " ")
| summarize Views = count(), ExamplePage = any(Page) by Style
| top 15 by Views desc
content.title: Top dance styles
content.subtitle: Dance style pages or style entities with the most views.

content.query:
let eventTowns = customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "view_event"
| extend Town = tostring(customDimensions.town)
| where isnotempty(Town)
| project Town, Source = "Event pages";
let townPages = customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend PageType = tostring(customDimensions.page_type), Entity = tostring(customDimensions.entity), Page = tostring(customDimensions.page), TownFromProps = tostring(customDimensions.town)
| where PageType == "town" or Entity startswith "town:"
| extend Town = case(isnotempty(TownFromProps), TownFromProps, Entity startswith "town:", substring(Entity, 5), Page startswith "/towns/", tostring(split(Page, "/")[2]), "")
| where isnotempty(Town)
| project Town, Source = "Town pages";
union eventTowns, townPages
| extend Town = replace_string(Town, "-", " ")
| summarize Views = count() by Town, Source
| top 15 by Views desc
content.title: Top towns
content.subtitle: Towns from event views plus town pages.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend Page = tostring(customDimensions.page), PageType = tostring(customDimensions.page_type)
| extend Page = iif(isempty(Page), "(not set)", Page)
| summarize Views = count() by Page, PageType
| top 25 by Views desc
content.title: Most-visited pages
content.subtitle: The site paths people opened most often.

content.json:
## What people search for

Use these tables to spot missing content, confusing labels, and popular filters.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "search"
| extend Term = tostring(customDimensions.term), Results = todouble(customDimensions.results), Location = tostring(customDimensions.location)
| extend Term = iif(isempty(Term), "(blank)", Term)
| summarize Searches = count(), AverageResults = round(avg(Results), 1) by Term, Location
| top 25 by Searches desc
content.title: Top search terms
content.subtitle: Terms people typed, with the average number of results they saw.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "search"
| extend Term = tostring(customDimensions.term), Results = todouble(customDimensions.results), Location = tostring(customDimensions.location)
| where Results == 0
| extend Term = iif(isempty(Term), "(blank)", Term)
| summarize Searches = count(), LastSeen = max(timestamp) by Term, Location
| top 25 by Searches desc
content.title: Searches that found nothing
content.subtitle: These are good ideas for missing event names, towns, styles, or spelling help.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "filter_events"
| mv-expand FilterRaw = split(tostring(customDimensions.filter), ",") to typeof(string)
| extend Filter = trim(" ", tostring(FilterRaw))
| where isnotempty(Filter)
| summarize Uses = count() by Filter
| order by Uses desc
content.title: Filters people use
content.subtitle: Counts each filter name, even when several filters were changed together.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "filter_events"
| extend Filter = tostring(customDimensions.filter), Results = todouble(customDimensions.results), Location = tostring(customDimensions.location)
| mv-expand ValueRaw = split(tostring(customDimensions.value), ",") to typeof(string)
| extend Value = trim(" ", tostring(ValueRaw))
| where isnotempty(Value)
| summarize Uses = count(), AverageResults = round(avg(Results), 1) by Value, Filter, Location
| top 25 by Uses desc
content.title: Top filter values
content.subtitle: Values people choose inside filters, such as towns or styles.

content.json:
## From looking to going

This section shows whether people move from reading event pages to actions like calendars, directions, sharing, and organizer links.

content.title: From event page to action
content.subtitle: Shows how often event views turn into actions. Percent is compared with event page views.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "add_to_calendar"
| extend Method = tostring(customDimensions.method)
| extend Method = iif(isempty(Method), "unknown", Method)
| summarize Clicks = count() by Method
| order by Clicks desc
content.title: Add-to-calendar methods
content.subtitle: Which calendar choices people use.

content.query:
let pageViews = customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend PageType = tostring(customDimensions.page_type)
| where PageType in ("events", "calendar", "map")
| summarize Count = count() by Activity = "Page views", Experience = PageType;
let switches = customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend PageType = tostring(customDimensions.page_type), RefPage = tostring(customDimensions.ref_page)
| where PageType in ("events", "calendar", "map") and RefPage in ("events", "calendar", "map") and RefPage != PageType
| summarize Count = count() by Activity = "Switched from another view", Experience = strcat(RefPage, " to ", PageType);
union pageViews, switches
| order by Activity asc, Count desc
content.title: List, calendar, and map usage
content.subtitle: Compares the event list, calendar, and map, plus switches between those views.

content.json:
## Sharing

See how often people open sharing tools and which pages or events they share.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "share"
| extend Method = tostring(customDimensions.method)
| extend Method = iif(isempty(Method), "unknown", Method)
| summarize Shares = count() by Method
| order by Shares desc
content.title: Shares by method
content.subtitle: How people share events or pages.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "share"
| summarize Shares = count() by Day = startofday(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "America/New_York"))
| order by Day asc
content.title: Shares over time
content.subtitle: Completed share actions by day.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in ("share_open", "share")
| extend Action = iif(name == "share_open", "Opened share preview", "Completed share")
| summarize Count = count() by Action
| order by Count desc
content.title: Share previews opened and shares completed
content.subtitle: Preview means someone opened the share panel; completed means they chose a share method.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "share"
| extend EventSlug = tostring(customDimensions.event_slug), Entity = tostring(customDimensions.entity), Page = tostring(customDimensions.page)
| extend SharedThing = case(isnotempty(EventSlug), replace_string(replace_regex(EventSlug, @"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-", ""), "-", " "), isnotempty(Entity), replace_string(Entity, ":", ": "), isnotempty(Page), Page, "(not set)")
| summarize Shares = count(), Methods = make_set(tostring(customDimensions.method), 10) by SharedThing
| top 25 by Shares desc
content.title: Most-shared events and pages
content.subtitle: Events or pages that people shared most.

content.json:
## Community

Community features include likes, saves, notes, photos, flags, reports, and sign-in checks.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name startswith "community_" or name == "report_problem"
| extend Action = case(
    name == "community_like", strcat("Like: ", tostring(customDimensions.value)),
    name == "community_save", strcat("Save: ", tostring(customDimensions.value)),
    name == "community_note", strcat("Note: ", tostring(customDimensions.result)),
    name == "community_photo", strcat("Photo: ", tostring(customDimensions.result)),
    name == "community_flag" or name == "report_problem", "Report or flag",
    name)
| summarize Count = count() by Day = startofday(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "America/New_York")), Action
| order by Day asc
content.title: Community actions over time
content.subtitle: Likes, saves, notes, photos, and reports sent by visitors.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "roles"
| summarize SignIns = count(), Failed = countif(tobool(success) == false) by Day = startofday(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "America/New_York"))
| order by Day asc
content.title: Sign-ins
content.subtitle: A request named roles means one visitor sign-in check.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in ("likes", "saves", "comments", "photos", "flags")
| summarize Requests = count(), Failed = countif(tobool(success) == false), P95DurationMs = round(percentile(duration, 95), 1) by Function = name
| extend FailureRatePercent = iif(Requests == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * Failed / Requests, 1))
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Community requests to the server
content.subtitle: Requests for likes, saves, comments, photos, and flags.

content.json:
## Where visitors come from

Which websites sent people here, and which tagged links they used (links with `utm_source`, for example in a newsletter or Facebook post). **Direct** means typed in, a bookmark, or an app that hides where the visit came from.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend Referrer = tolower(tostring(customDimensions.ref))
| where isnotempty(Referrer) and Referrer !in ("internal", "direct")
| summarize PageViews = count() by Referrer
| top 25 by PageViews desc
content.title: Websites that sent visitors
content.subtitle: Other sites that sent people here. Internal links are hidden.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend Source = tostring(customDimensions.utm_source), Medium = tostring(customDimensions.utm_medium), Campaign = tostring(customDimensions.utm_campaign)
| where isnotempty(Source) or isnotempty(Medium) or isnotempty(Campaign)
| summarize PageViews = count() by Source, Medium, Campaign
| order by PageViews desc
content.title: Campaign links
content.subtitle: UTM values from links you shared in email, social posts, or ads.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend Referrer = tolower(tostring(customDimensions.ref))
| extend Referrer = iif(isempty(Referrer), "direct", Referrer)
| extend SourceGroup = case(
    Referrer == "direct", "Direct",
    Referrer has_any ("google.", "bing.com", "duckduckgo.com", "yahoo.com", "chatgpt.com", "perplexity.ai", "copilot.microsoft.com", "gemini.google.com", "claude.ai"), "Search and AI",
    Referrer has_any ("facebook.com", "instagram.com", "t.co", "x.com", "whatsapp.com", "linkedin.com"), "Social",
    Referrer == "internal", "Internal site links",
    "Other sites")
| where SourceGroup != "Internal site links"
| summarize PageViews = count() by SourceGroup
| order by PageViews desc
content.title: Direct, search, social, and other sites
content.subtitle: Groups referrers into plain-language sources.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend Referrer = tolower(tostring(customDimensions.ref))
| where Referrer has_any ("chatgpt.com", "perplexity.ai", "copilot.microsoft.com", "gemini.google.com", "claude.ai")
| summarize PageViews = count() by Referrer
| order by PageViews desc
content.title: AI assistants
content.subtitle: Visits referred by AI assistants when the browser sends that referrer.

content.json:
## Phones and computers

Whether visits come from phones, tablets or computers. Visits from before October 5, 2026 show as "unknown".

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend Device = tostring(customDimensions.device)
| extend Device = iif(isempty(Device), "unknown", Device)
| summarize PageViews = count() by Device
| order by PageViews desc
content.title: Page views by device
content.subtitle: Phone, tablet, desktop, or unknown when the older event did not include device yet.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend Device = tostring(customDimensions.device)
| extend Device = iif(isempty(Device), "unknown", Device)
| summarize PageViews = count() by Day = startofday(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "America/New_York")), Device
| order by Day asc
content.title: Device use over time
content.subtitle: Daily page views split by phone, tablet, desktop, or unknown.

content.json:
## How fast pages load (Core Web Vitals)

How quickly pages appear and respond on visitors' phones and computers. Each number is the time that **3 out of 4 visits beat** (Google uses the same measure). **LCP**: time until the main content shows (good: under 2,500 ms). **INP**: time until the page reacts to a tap or click (good: under 200 ms). **CLS**: how much things jump around while loading (good: under 100 here, which is Google's 0.1). These are close estimates.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in ("site.web.vitals.lcp", "site.web.vitals.inp", "site.web.vitals.cls")
| extend Metric = case(name endswith ".lcp", "LCP load time (ms)", name endswith ".inp", "INP tap/click response (ms)", "CLS layout shift (x1000)")
| extend AverageValue = iif(valueCount > 0, valueSum / valueCount, value)
| summarize ApproxThreeOutOfFour = round(percentile(AverageValue, 75), 1) by Day = startofday(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "America/New_York")), Metric
| extend GoodIfAtOrBelow = case(Metric == "LCP load time (ms)", 2500.0, Metric == "INP tap/click response (ms)", 200.0, Metric == "CLS layout shift (x1000)", 100.0, real(null))
| order by Day asc
content.title: How fast pages load each day
content.subtitle: Approximate: 3 out of 4 visits are this fast or faster. Good targets: LCP 2500 ms or less, INP 200 ms or less, CLS 100 or less.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in ("site.web.vitals.lcp", "site.web.vitals.inp", "site.web.vitals.cls")
| extend Metric = case(name endswith ".lcp", "LCP load time (ms)", name endswith ".inp", "INP tap/click response (ms)", "CLS layout shift (x1000)")
| extend PageType = tostring(customDimensions.page_type), Rating = tostring(customDimensions.rating)
| extend PageType = iif(isempty(PageType), "unknown", PageType)
| extend AverageValue = iif(valueCount > 0, valueSum / valueCount, value), SampleCount = iif(valueCount > 0, valueCount, 1)
| summarize ApproxThreeOutOfFour = round(percentile(AverageValue, 75), 1), Good = sumif(SampleCount, Rating == "good"), NeedsImprovement = sumif(SampleCount, Rating == "needs-improvement"), Poor = sumif(SampleCount, Rating == "poor") by Metric, PageType
| extend Total = Good + NeedsImprovement + Poor
| extend GoodSharePercent = iif(Total == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * Good / Total, 1))
| order by Metric asc, ApproxThreeOutOfFour desc
content.title: Page speed by page type
content.subtitle: Approximate values from pre-aggregated metric rows. Good share is the percent of samples rated good by the browser library.

content.json:
## Problems

Broken links people followed (missing pages), script errors in browsers, failures in the site's server functions, and visit reports the server refused.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "js_error"
| extend Message = tostring(customDimensions.message), Source = tostring(customDimensions.source), Line = tostring(customDimensions.line)
| extend Message = iif(isempty(Message), "(not set)", Message), Source = iif(isempty(Source), "(not set)", Source)
| summarize Errors = count(), LastSeen = max(timestamp) by Message, Source, Line
| top 25 by Errors desc
content.title: Script errors in browsers
content.subtitle: Browser errors grouped by short message and script file.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| where tostring(customDimensions.page_type) == "404"
| extend MissingPage = tostring(customDimensions.page), Referrer = tostring(customDimensions.ref)
| extend MissingPage = iif(isempty(MissingPage), "(not set)", MissingPage)
| summarize Hits = count(), LastSeen = max(timestamp), Referrers = make_set(Referrer, 10) by MissingPage
| top 25 by Hits desc
content.title: Missing pages
content.subtitle: 404 page views show paths visitors tried that did not exist.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests = count(), Failed = countif(tobool(success) == false), P95DurationMs = round(percentile(duration, 95), 1) by Function = name
| extend FailureRatePercent = iif(Requests == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * Failed / Requests, 1))
| order by Failed desc, Requests desc
content.title: Server functions: requests, failures and speed
content.subtitle: Request count, failure rate, and slowest 5% cutoff by Azure Function name.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tobool(success) == false
| summarize FailedRequests = count() by Day = startofday(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "America/New_York")), Function = name
| order by Day asc
content.title: Failed server requests over time
content.subtitle: Daily failed Azure Function requests.

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend ProblemType = tostring(type), Message = tostring(outerMessage)
| extend ProblemType = iif(isempty(ProblemType), "(not set)", ProblemType), Message = iif(isempty(Message), "(not set)", Message)
| summarize Exceptions = count(), LastSeen = max(timestamp) by ProblemType, Message
| top 25 by Exceptions desc
content.title: Server errors
content.subtitle: Exceptions recorded by the API.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "site.telemetry.rejected"
| extend Reason = tostring(customDimensions.reason)
| extend Reason = iif(isempty(Reason), "unknown", Reason)
| summarize Rejected = sum(valueSum) by Reason
| order by Rejected desc
content.title: Visit reports the server refused
content.subtitle: Telemetry requests rejected by validation or rate limits.

content.json:
## When people visit

Local time is converted to New York time so planning matches the community schedule.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend LocalTime = datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "America/New_York")
| extend DayNumber = toint(dayofweek(LocalTime) / 1d), Hour = datetime_part("hour", LocalTime)
| extend DayOrder = iif(DayNumber == 0, 7, DayNumber)
| extend Day = case(DayNumber == 1, "Mon", DayNumber == 2, "Tue", DayNumber == 3, "Wed", DayNumber == 4, "Thu", DayNumber == 5, "Fri", DayNumber == 6, "Sat", "Sun")
| summarize Views = count() by DayOrder, Day, Hour
| evaluate pivot(Hour, sum(Views), DayOrder, Day)
| order by DayOrder asc
content.title: Page views by day and hour
content.subtitle: Heatmap-style table in New York time. Darker cells mean more page views.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "page_view"
| extend LocalTime = datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "America/New_York")
| extend DayNumber = toint(dayofweek(LocalTime) / 1d)
| extend DayOrder = iif(DayNumber == 0, 7, DayNumber)
| extend Day = case(DayNumber == 1, "Mon", DayNumber == 2, "Tue", DayNumber == 3, "Wed", DayNumber == 4, "Thu", DayNumber == 5, "Fri", DayNumber == 6, "Sat", "Sun")
| summarize PageViews = count() by DayOrder, Day
| order by DayOrder asc
content.title: Busiest days of the week
content.subtitle: Page views by weekday in New York time.

content.json:
## Data budget

How much monitoring data the site stores each day. The free limit we set is 0.1 GB (100 MB) a day. If it is reached, Azure stops storing new data until the next day, so charts can have gaps; an alert emails the owner if that happens.

content.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where tobool(IsBillable) == true
| summarize IngestedMB = round(sum(Quantity), 3) by Day = startofday(TimeGenerated), Table = DataType
| extend DailyCapMB = 102.4
| extend PercentOfDailyCap = round(100.0 * IngestedMB / DailyCapMB, 1)
| order by Day asc, IngestedMB desc
content.title: Monitoring data used each day (MB)
content.subtitle: Shows how many MB were ingested into Log Analytics and compares each table with the 0.1 GB daily cap.
